Pointer value `local_14` truncated by cast to `int` (sub-pointer width) — correct on the 32-bit matching build, a hard `cast from pointer to smaller type` error at 64-bit. If the value is used as an integer (delta, address print, hash), rewrite the cast as `uintptr_t`/`intptr_t` in a .keep.

Raw hex address 0x1d81080 assigned to bare local `pCVar3`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `pCVar3` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.

'pCVar5[4].actor_name + 0xc' walks 4 x sizeof(CDemonActor) (0x158) + offsetof(actor_name) (0x0) + 0xc = 0x56c, which is exactly offsetof(CChain, cached_distance). Ghidra had no CChain type here and reached the field by index arithmetic; write it as ((CChain *)pCVar5)->cached_distance (§de-pun/§12). Ambiguous: CGlass::render_vertices[11], CWeapon::ammo_type also has a field there — confirm the real class from the .asm before rewriting.

'(char *)&pCVar5[2].location.position.y' walks 2 x sizeof(CDemonActor) (0x158) + offsetof(location.position.y) (0x24) + 0x0 = 0x2d4, which is exactly offsetof(CAmmo, weapon_class_name). Ghidra had no CAmmo type here and reached the field by index arithmetic; write it as ((CAmmo *)pCVar5)->weapon_class_name (§de-pun/§12). Ambiguous: CAmmoBox::weapon_class_name, CBattery::carrier, CBoxActor::loop_wav_name also has a field there — confirm the real class from the .asm before rewriting.
